messages.body:
Tracking issue for **P3.DEMO.BG** — WebGL slide backgrounds for the demo deck, spun out of #22 (parallel task per the thread).

## Scope
- A small library of WebGL background scenes — mathy/sciency patterns (fractals, flow fields, particle systems, reaction–diffusion, and similar), one per slide of the #22 deck. The cooler the better.
- Come up with several distinct patterns and make it easy to assign one per slide; consistent API (mount/unmount, resize, reduced-motion fallback) so the deck can drop them in.
- Not throwaway: build them as reusable components inside the actual particle UI codebase so they evolve in sync with the product (per the direction in #22).
- Backgrounds must stay background: dark, low-contrast, GPU-cheap, and legible under the VERY SIMPLE LARGE LETTERS slide rule — they support the text, never compete with it.

## Non-goals (stay with #22)
The deck itself, the timelapse slide, subtitles, and slide copy — this task only supplies the background layer.
